shortDescription: NetApp Cloud Manager connector for AWS

options.name: account_id
options.description: The NetApp tenancy account ID.

options.name: ami
options.description: The image ID.

options.name: associate_public_ip_address
options.description: Indicates whether to associate a public IP address to the instance. If not provided, the association will be done based on the subnet's configuration.

options.name: aws_tag
options.description: Additional tags for the AWS EC2 instance.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The unique client ID of the Connector. The connector ID.

options.name: company
options.description: The name of the company of the user.

options.name: enable_termination_protection
options.description: Indicates whether to enable termination protection on the instance.

options.name: environment
options.description: The environment for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored.

options.name: iam_instance_profile_name
options.description: The name of the instance profile for the Connector.

options.name: instance_id
options.description: The ID of the EC2 instance used for delete.

options.name: instance_type
options.description: The type of instance (for example, t3.xlarge). At least 4 CPU and 16 GB of memory are required.

options.name: key_name
options.description: The name of the key pair to use for the Connector instance.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Cloud Manager connector for AWS to manage.

options.name: proxy_certificates
options.description: The proxy certificates, a list of certificate file names.

options.name: proxy_password
options.description: The proxy password, if using a proxy to connect to the internet.

options.name: proxy_url
options.description: The proxy URL, if using a proxy to connect to the internet.

options.name: proxy_user_name
options.description: The proxy user name, if using a proxy to connect to the internet.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: The refresh token for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: region
options.description: The region where the Cloud Manager Connector will be created.

options.name: sa_client_id
options.description: The service account secret client ID for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: sa_secret_key
options.description: The service account secret key for NetApp Cloud Manager API operations.

options.name: security_group_ids
options.description: The IDs of the security groups for the instance, multiple security groups can be provided separated by ','.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified Cloud Manager connector for AWS should exist or not.

options.name: subnet_id
options.description: The ID of the subnet for the instance.
